## Schedule

Twenty-eight meetings in two parts. **Part I** (sessions 1–12) builds the
workbench on tabular data: you work by hand through session 7, and AI enters at
session 8. **Part II** (sessions 13–28) takes one data family per session through
the same pipeline, with wide delegation to AI and verification as the graded
skill.

Topics link to their session page once it is published; the sidebar lists the
same pages.

::: {.schedule}
{{< include _schedule.qmd >}}

## Homework

Thirteen assignments, out on Thursdays and due the following Thursday at 8:40 am.
Each one is an investigation against real data, not an exercise set. The last is
a two-week assignment.
